subject: tool:gdl-memory-graph
value: A TYPED DENIAL WHOSE `expiry_check` READS THE POSTPROCESSED OBJECT OF A WEBFRANK-PINNED FUNCTION IS UNFALSIFIABLE IN ONE OF TWO WAYS, AND THE SECOND DESTROYS STANDING CONCLUSIONS. v1 of this law established the class and the population; this version corrects two things measured by re-running all thirteen at c0f978273 (attempt.CX_vacuous-expiry-remediation-thirteen-rerun-raw-ten-confirm-three-expire-and-the-census-had-two-false-rows.20260904.v1). CORRECTION ONE -- THERE ARE TWO FAILURE MODES, not one. (a) NEVER-FIRES: the trigger is keyed on a reading the postprocessed object gives BY CONSTRUCTION -- `real 0`, an IDENTICAL opcode multiset, the absence of a ROLE MISMATCH row -- so the check passes forever and the denial is immortal. Two of the thirteen: attempt.CL_crittergettargetplayers-...v1 (wants 'anything other than an IDENTICAL 128/128 multiset') and attempt.SB_do-enemies-...v1 (tests for the strings EMISSION ORDER and ROLE MISMATCH, which the default savedregs read does not print on a pinned function). (b) ALWAYS-FIRES, i.e. FALSE EXPIRY: the trigger is keyed on a NONZERO premise value the postprocessed read can never show again -- `real 18`, `real 48`, `real 6`, `frame target 40 ours 48`, `the four cluster lines at @424-@440`, `target-only +1 mr / ours-only -1 li`. NINE of the thirteen. A lane running one of these is told a LIVE denial has lapsed, which is worse than being told nothing: it invites re-probing an axis that is still dead. v1's title names only the harmless half. CORRECTION TWO -- THE POPULATION IS ELEVEN, NOT THIRTEEN, and the screen's discriminant was wrong. v1 screened for 'the expiry_check names a postprocess-reading tool (probe.py, fndiff.py, savedregs.py, slotdiff.py, regnorm.py)'. It did not ask whether the named tool reads the RAW body, and two rows do. `composed_census/wr_const_closure_probe.py` prints `game/ui/attract::scroll_credits  (raw postprocess body, 148 insns)` as its own first line and reproduced attempt.WR_scroll-credits-...v1's refusal on a pinned function -- that denial was never vacuous. attempt.MC_init-all-dir-info-...v1 is HALF: its clause (b) names `composed_census/hv_try.py`, which reproduced `+0x14: base register presence differs (g3 vs g0)` and `+0x18: no proof mode offered` verbatim on a pinned function, while its clause (a) names `probe.py --ops` and is vacuous. SO THE SHIPPABLE SCREEN IS NOT A TOOL-NAME LIST: it is a per-tool RAW-versus-POSTPROCESSED attribute joined against config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json. A name-list screen would have refused two sound denials AND would pass any future raw-blind tool that is not on the list. THE CURE FOR AN AUTHOR IS UNCHANGED AND NOW SHOWN TO WORK: state the premise as a RAW obligation. Ten of the thirteen re-ruled CONFIRMED on the raw read this way, several to the digit -- attempt.SA_playerprocesspowerups-volatile-half-...v1's own word test reproduced as `+0x0cfc  O 82df06d0  T 831f06d0` -- so the raw form is not merely sound, it is the form under which these denials keep their evidentiary value.
